name: atomberg-mcp
description: Connect ChatGPT and Codex to supported Atomberg smart-home devices through Atomberg's OAuth-protected MCP server.

interface.longDescription: Connect your Atomberg account to discover and interact with supported smart-home devices. Available actions depend on the devices and permissions associated with your connected Atomberg account.
defaultPrompt: Check the status of my Atomberg devices.
Help me control a supported Atomberg device.
